hints.title: Group by Digit Sum
hints.text: Compute the sum of digits for each number, grouping numbers with identical digit sums.

hints.title: Maintain Largest Seen
hints.text: For each digit sum group, you only need to pair the current number with the largest previous number in that group.

hints.title: Online Maximum Updating
hints.text: Iterate through the array while maintaining the highest number seen so far for each digit sum.

hints.title: Digit Sum Hash Table Implementation

variables: D: maximum distinct digit sums (at most 82 for 10^9)
complexity.notes: Digit sum computation takes logarithmic time in number size.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all pairs takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map stores up to 82 integer values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Solves in one pass by grouping by digit sum and tracking top element.
